provider_only: Fetch actual GitHub issue and all original comments; reject wrong/closed issue, truncation, same-owner, duplicate authors/repositories/commits, any source unbound to CE frozen exact identities. No self-issued provider-verified flags.
provider_commit_requirement: For each C/D, fresh GitHub REST original git/commits/SHA and commits/SHA responses, original git tree SHA, provider verified signature true with nonblank reason/signature, rest author login equals original issue commenter/claimed creator, exact commit SHA and tree hash. Distinct external creators and repos; no self-controlled FORGE origin accepted.
provider_blob_requirement: Original tree recursive complete nontruncated and three exact declared blobs at literal clean paths, their Git object SHA and fetched content verified by the Git blob hash sha1(b'blob '+len+'\\0'+raw). Provider returned base64 decoded strictly with byte budget 100k/source/oracle and 30k attestation. Never execute/compile/import/load outside source or private oracle, and never retain their contents in GitHub artifacts or logs. Only emit SHA, path and descriptive attestation non-secret metadata.
static_source_check: Parse Python source and oracle by ast.parse without execution. Reject dynamic execution calls eval/exec/compile/__import__ and imports of prior frozen model, FORGE/research/optimizer/nativeevidence. AST static inspection cannot prove non-copying or semantic novelty.
attestation_requirements: JSON schema mass.f124cf.signed-origin-attestation.v1, binds exact CE protocol commit/blob, family and original claimed creator, explicit independently_originated/no_model_access_or_copied_source/no_prior_case_or_seed_reuse/no_protected_firstuse plus >=40-character source relationship novelty claim. Creator attestation is NOT independent novelty or authorship proof.
birth_chronology_caution: Record provider Git commit timestamps and signature as evidence only; author/committer dates can be spoofed, so do not accept or assert genuinely after-freeze birth from timestamp alone. Signed source commit must include frozen protocol identity in its signed attestation, and independent substantive chronology review remains required.
status: If 0 sources BLOCKED_NO_ORIGINS; if 1 BLOCKED_TWO_REQUIRED; if invalid/reused/or unsigned FAIL; if 2 source identities and blobs authenticated SOURCE_CUSTODY_ONLY_PENDING_AUTHORED_NOVELTY_REVIEW. NEVER label SCIENTIFIC_FIRSTUSE_ADMITTED.
test_plan: Windows and Ubuntu focused static adversarial metadata tests and deterministic fake-provider-JSON exact commit/tree/sha/git-object negative tests only; live original GitHub provider step once after they pass, with read-only token, reusing source identity. Never generate fake external sources or report fixture tokens as real authorship.
